# Game patches and hooks of Project Diablo 2 (1.13c)

<!-- Generated by tools/patches/build_patches.py from the binaries; do not edit (re-run the script). -->

Every change PD2 makes to the 1.13c game code, one row per **hook** (a group of contiguous patch records written by one table run, e.g. the `E8` byte + its rel32 + the NOPs after it). The per-record data (original/new bytes, table address, condition) is in `patches.csv`; `FEATURES.md` groups the hooks by feature. "Original" is the disassembly of the shipped stock DLL at that spot, "PD2" the same bytes after the patch (relative targets computed with ProjectDiablo.dll at its preferred base 0x10000000). Game names come from `sigmaRE/5_game_source/<Module>/symbols.csv`; `sub_<va>` marks an entry point the reference did not split off.
